column1: # decision is block (exit 2) / advise (exit 0, additionalContext) / fallthrough
# (exit 0, no output). Tab-separated; # and blank lines ignored. '-' marks an
# absent isolation/nested/model value — never a truly empty field between tabs,
# since a whitespace-split reader collapses runs of empty fields, which is a
# property of this table's own encoding rather than of any one reader of it. Any
# other model value is a named model; the kit names none.
# The reader fixes one roster for the whole table: DELEGATION_KIT_READONLY_TYPES=(ro-type).
# A subagent_type prefixed 'noroster:' runs with no roster config at all (an
# empty declare), proving D2 stays inert on the roster's absence rather than on
# this type's absence from a populated one. A subagent_type prefixed 'armed:'
# and one definition stating model:, for tiered-type. Either prefix is stripped
# before it reaches the guard's payload. subagent_type UNPARSEABLE sends invalid
# JSON on stdin instead of a built payload.
# D1 — the fork ban is unconditional

column6: a fork dispatch blocks regardless of isolation or roster
a typed, non-fork dispatch is not blocked (no roster configured)

column1: # D2 — a declared read-only type without isolation: worktree

column6: a rostered type dispatched without isolation: worktree blocks
the same rostered type with isolation: worktree does not block
a typed dispatch outside a populated roster does not block
D2 stays inert against an empty roster, even naming the type that would otherwise match

column1: # D4 — default isolation: a type outside a populated mutating roster takes isolation: worktree

column6: an undeclared type dispatched unisolated blocks
an absent type is the harness default, which no roster declares, so it blocks
the same undeclared type isolated does not block
a declared mutating type unisolated does not block
D4 stays inert against an empty mutating roster

column1: # D5 — the chosen tier: a dispatch names its model or its type's definition states one

column6: a dispatch naming no model, of a type no definition tiers, blocks
the same dispatch naming its model does not block
a type whose definition states model: needs no model at dispatch
D5 stays inert while its switch is off
a payload carrying agent_id advises: this dispatch creates a grandchild
a payload with no agent_id falls through D3 untouched
an unparseable payload advises rather than blocks, naming what could not be enforced
